status: Known synthetic mathematical calibration; no manuscript fit or prospective evidence
width: literal Python string length of the fixed nonempty ASCII labels
law: IID label draws from the exact declared positive probabilities; preserve initial transient
boundary_inclusion: Consecutive rows must both be overflow-closed; include all such boundaries; exclude every edge touching the final unclosed tail
capacity_domain: capacity >= 2*maximum label width + separator; guarantees at least two tokens in each completed row
metric: Unit insertion/deletion/substitution Levenshtein cost divided by maximum nonempty label length; no transposition, case folding or normalization
incoming_pair_reference: Independent incoming label draws, including repeated-label pairs
width_pair_reference: mu(u,v)=sum p(a|w(a)=u)*p(b|w(b)=v)*d(a,b) over every ordered label pair in the width bins
estimands: equal eligible streams: E[sum cost/boundary count | boundary count>0]
zero_boundary_handling: Retain every stream and exact probability; its sum/count remain 0, its mean is null; any zero-denominator case mean/contrast is null
conditional_prediction: Exact centered mean against the width-pair reference is zero under both estimands and in every positive-probability eligible complete-width-sequence class
unconditional_prediction: No prescribed sign or success criterion; retain every contrast against the incoming-pair reference
ledger: All exact label streams, probabilities, completed-row/tail traces, boundary positions/widths/costs, per-stream sums/means and all case eligibility/denominator ledgers
exclusions: No additional stream, boundary, law or capacity filtering; no stationary approximation or random simulation
publication: Protocol/settings published and remote head verified before outcome calculations; known-law zero results are calibration, not independently certified preregistration
